chunks: And Ishaq ibn Ammar narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
A man complained to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم about trade. So he said: “Look for goods, buy them, then sell them; whatever you profit from therein, then adhere to it.”

key_terms.الْحِرْفَةَ: trade, craft, or means of earning a livelihood
key_terms.بُيُوعًا: goods or items of sale in commercial exchange
key_terms.فَالْزَمْهُ: then stick to it or remain committed to it

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم advise a man who complained about his livelihood or trade?
ai.summary: This hadith relates that a man complained about his trade or livelihood to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and he was directed toward buying and selling goods to discover a profitable line of work. It highlights practical engagement in lawful commerce and persistence in what proves beneficial.
